create_AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter to track running average and current value of a metric
update_AverageMeter: update an AverageMeter with a new value and optional sample count
synchronize_AverageMeter: synchronize an AverageMeter across distributed processes using torch distributed all_reduce
create_ProgressMeter: create a ProgressMeter with a list of AverageMeters to display batch progress
display_ProgressMeter: display the current batch progress and all meter values to stdout
